releases.displayName: New Official Screenshots + Closed Beta Update

items.text: Today we have two new Tormented Souls updates to share with you!

We have just added a batch of new screenshots to the Steam page, taken from the latest build, which you can view at the top of the Steam page. We are still working hard on improving everything about Tormented Souls - but we hope that they give you even more of a flavour of what we're looking to bring to the game. Including...

Dark forces and unspeakable horrors will do everything in their power to stop Caroline getting to the truth. Use anything and everything that you can find to fight back against the evils that wait in the darkness.

Scavenge essential resources and tools, manage your inventory, decipher clues from long-forgotten journals, and combine it all to solve fiendish puzzles and unravel the secrets of the mansion-turned-hospital.
Nothing is as it seems at Winterlake. And when you discover a shimmering mirror in a dark corner of the mansion, your understanding of reality will be challenged in a whole new way...

We are currently running a Closed Beta for Tormented Souls and already we have received so much useful feedback to help us take the game to the next level. We're sorry that not everybody could take part in this Beta test, but please keep an eye on the Steam page for more information about the improvements we're making to the game - and also for future opportunities to help us test & improve Tormented Souls.
The development team are currently hard at work on the Beta Build of Tormented Souls - and we wanted to share a short gameplay snapshot with you to show the game's progress so far:

We hope that you like what you see in the footage! There is still a long way to go and we have many improvements to make, but every day we get closer to the immersive and atmospheric classic survival horror game we want to bring to you.
